PATIENT IDENTIFIER: PT-101 | NAME: Elena Rostova | DOB/AGE: 62yo Female | REF DATE: 2026-11-14
CLINICAL ENCOUNTER: Thoracic Medical Oncology New Trial Screening Consultation (Target: NCT04613596 Phase 3)

=== DEMOGRAPHICS & CLINICAL SUMMARY ===
Elena Rostova is a 62-year-old female (nonsmoker, 12 pack-year distant history quit 2008) presenting for first-line systemic therapy evaluation for newly diagnosed metastatic lung adenocarcinoma.

=== DIAGNOSIS & STAGE ===
Primary Diagnosis: Stage IV (cT2aN2M1b) non-squamous Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC), adenocarcinoma histology, confirmed via CT-guided core biopsy of right upper lobe mass on 2026-09-10.
Target Disease Burden (RECIST 1.1): Measurable 3.4 cm right upper lobe (RUL) primary pulmonary mass (CT chest/abdomen/pelvis 2026-11-05), hilar/mediastinal adenopathy, and solitary treated CNS metastasis.
Prior Systemic Therapy for Metastatic Disease: None (0 prior systemic lines; treatment-naive).

=== PATHOLOGY & MOLECULAR NGS ===
Tissue Next-Generation Sequencing (FoundationOne CDx, report finalized 2026-09-22):
- KRAS: p.G12C (c.34G>T) pathogenic mutation DETECTED (VAF 28.4%).
- EGFR (exons 18-21): Negative / Wild-Type (no sensitizing mutations).
- ALK Rearrangement (FISH & RNA fusion): Negative.
- ROS1 / RET / MET / BRAF / NTRK: Negative.
PD-L1 Immunohistochemistry (22C3 pharmDx): TPS = 65% (High expression >= 50%).

=== BRAIN MRI / CNS IMAGING ===
2026-09-24 Brain MRI w/ contrast: Single 1.2 cm left parietal lobe parenchymal metastasis with minimal vasogenic edema; zero brainstem lesions, no leptomeningeal enhancement, no midline shift.
2026-09-30 Stereotactic Radiosurgery (SRS): Single-fraction 20 Gy Gamma Knife SRS delivered to 1.2 cm left parietal lesion (completed 45 days prior to 2026-11-14).
2026-11-06 Follow-up Brain MRI: Post-SRS stability of 1.2 cm left parietal lesion, resolution of perilesional edema, no new CNS lesions, neurologically asymptomatic, no seizures.

=== RADIATION ONCOLOGY HISTORY ===
- 2026-09-30: Cranial SRS (20 Gy x 1 fx) to left parietal brain metastasis (45 days prior to 2026-11-14).
- Thoracic / Lung Radiotherapy: None (0 Gy prior thoracic or lung irradiation).

=== ACTIVE & PRIOR MEDICATIONS ===
- Dexamethasone (taper completed): Started 2 mg PO daily on 2026-09-28 post-SRS; tapered and discontinued permanently on 2026-10-15 (off systemic corticosteroids for 30 days prior to 2026-11-14; current daily prednisone equivalent = 0.0 mg/day).
- Atorvastatin 20 mg PO daily (chronic hyperlipidemia).
- Lisinopril 10 mg PO daily (well-controlled hypertension).
- Prior Systemic Anticancer / Investigational Agents: None. No live vaccines in past 90 days. No major surgery in past 60 days.

=== LABORATORY PANEL (Collected 2026-11-12) ===
- Renal Function: Serum Creatinine 0.85 mg/dL | eGFR (CKD-EPI): 78 mL/min/1.73m2 (Reference >= 50).
- Hepatic Function: AST 24 U/L (ULN 40) | ALT 29 U/L (ULN 40) | Total Bilirubin 0.7 mg/dL (ULN 1.2).
- Hematology: WBC 6.4 K/uL | Absolute Neutrophil Count (ANC): 4,200 /uL | Hemoglobin 12.6 g/dL | Platelets: 245,000 /uL.

=== ECOG PERFORMANCE STATUS ===
ECOG Performance Status: 1 (symptomatic mild exertional dyspnea, fully ambulatory and independent in all ADLs).
Assessor Note: Meets all NCT04613596 Phase 3 inclusion criteria; zero exclusion triggers.

PATIENT IDENTIFIER: PT-102 | NAME: Marcus Vance | DOB/AGE: 68yo Male | REF DATE: 2026-11-14
CLINICAL ENCOUNTER: Phase 3 / Phase 1/2 Trial Eligibility Review (Targets: NCT04613596 & NCT04787042)

=== DEMOGRAPHICS & CLINICAL SUMMARY ===
Marcus Vance is a 68-year-old male (40 pack-year former smoker) evaluated for enrollment into NCT04613596 (KRYSTAL-7 Phase 3) and NCT04787042 (ST-067 Phase 1/2) for metastatic NSCLC.

=== DIAGNOSIS & STAGE ===
Primary Diagnosis: Stage IV (cT2bN2M1c) squamous/non-squamous NSCLC (adenocarcinoma predominant), diagnosed 2026-08-18.
Target Disease Burden (RECIST 1.1): Measurable 4.1 cm left lower lobe (LLL) pulmonary mass with ipsilateral mediastinal lymphadenopathy and solitary right frontal brain metastasis.

=== PATHOLOGY & MOLECULAR NGS ===
Tissue NGS Panel (finalized 2026-09-02):
- KRAS: p.G12C mutation DETECTED.
- EGFR: Negative / Wild-Type.
- ALK / ROS1 / NTRK: Negative.
PD-L1 Immunohistochemistry (22C3): TPS = 70% (>= 50%).

=== BRAIN MRI / CNS IMAGING ===
2026-10-31 Brain MRI w/ contrast: 1.6 cm right frontal lobe parenchymal metastasis with surrounding moderate vasogenic peritumoral edema causing mild left-sided clumsiness and morning headache. No brainstem lesion.

=== RADIATION ONCOLOGY HISTORY ===
- Prior Thoracic / Lung Radiotherapy: None.
- Neurosurgical/RT consultation pending for right frontal lesion; no cranial RT completed yet.

=== ACTIVE & PRIOR MEDICATIONS ===
- Dexamethasone 2 mg PO BID (total daily dose = 4.0 mg/day), started 2026-11-01 and ONGOING as of 2026-11-14 for symptomatic peritumoral edema around the 1.6 cm right frontal brain lesion.
  [Potency Calculation: 4.0 mg/day Dexamethasone * (5.0 / 0.75) = 26.7 mg/day Prednisone equivalent -> EXCEEDS 10.0 mg/day ceiling].
- Prior Systemic Anticancer Therapy: Completed 1 cycle of investigational anti-LAG-3 checkpoint modulator (relatlimab-class clinical study agent) in metastatic setting; last dose administered on 2026-10-26 (19 days prior to 2026-11-14; violates 28-day washout for NCT04787042 [earliest washout clearance: 2026-11-23] AND violates 0 prior metastatic systemic treatment lines for NCT04613596).
- Omeprazole 20 mg PO daily (GI prophylaxis).

=== LABORATORY PANEL (Collected 2026-11-12) ===
- Renal Function: eGFR 72 mL/min/1.73m2.
- Hepatic Function: AST 28 U/L (ULN 40) | ALT 31 U/L (ULN 40) | Total Bilirubin 0.8 mg/dL (ULN 1.2).
- Hematology: ANC 4,800 /uL | Platelets 220,000 /uL.

=== ECOG PERFORMANCE STATUS ===
ECOG Performance Status: 1.
Assessor Note: CONTRAINDICATED for both NCT04613596 and NCT04787042 due to supratherapeutic steroid dose (26.7 mg/day Prednisone eq) and recent investigational systemic therapy (19 days ago).

PATIENT IDENTIFIER: PT-103 | NAME: Sofia Morales | DOB/AGE: 57yo Female | REF DATE: 2026-11-14
CLINICAL ENCOUNTER: Early-Phase Solid Tumor Immunotherapy Screening (Target: NCT04787042)

=== DEMOGRAPHICS & CLINICAL SUMMARY ===
Sofia Morales is a 57-year-old female presenting for evaluation for NCT04787042 (Phase 1/2 ST-067 IL-18 trial) for progressive metastatic Triple-Negative Breast Cancer (TNBC).

=== DIAGNOSIS & STAGE ===
Primary Diagnosis: Stage IV metastatic Triple-Negative Breast Cancer (TNBC), progressive after 2 prior lines of systemic chemotherapy (last systemic paclitaxel/carboplatin cycle completed 2026-09-18, 57 days prior to 2026-11-14).
Target Disease Burden (RECIST 1.1): Measurable 2.8 cm segment VII hepatic metastasis (CT 2026-11-08).
Biopsy Accessibility: Accessible 2.1 cm right axillary lymph node suitable for mandatory pre- and on-treatment core needle biopsies.

=== PATHOLOGY & MOLECULAR NGS ===
Breast Tumor Receptor Profile (confirmed on metastatic core biopsy):
- Estrogen Receptor (ER): Negative (0%).
- Progesterone Receptor (PR): Negative (0%).
- HER2: IHC 0, FISH Negative (not amplified).
- BRCA1/2 germline: Wild-Type.

=== BRAIN MRI / CNS IMAGING ===
2026-10-20 Brain MRI w/ contrast: No intracranial metastasis or leptomeningeal disease.

=== RADIATION ONCOLOGY HISTORY ===
- 2026-06-29 to 2026-07-27: Palliative external beam radiotherapy to left thoracic chest wall / underlying left lung apex, total dose 45 Gy in 15 fractions, completed 2026-07-27 (110 days prior to 2026-11-14; violates >30 Gy thoracic/lung radiation within 180 days exclusion [earliest 180-day clearance: 2027-01-23]).

=== ACTIVE & PRIOR MEDICATIONS ===
- Systemic Corticosteroids: None (0 mg/day).
- Prior Systemic Therapy: Paclitaxel + Carboplatin completed 2026-09-18 (57 days prior to 2026-11-14; meets >=28-day washout).
- Ondansetron 4 mg PO PRN nausea; Acetaminophen 500 mg PO PRN.

=== LABORATORY PANEL (Collected 2026-11-12) ===
- Renal Function: eGFR 81 mL/min/1.73m2.
- Hepatic Function: AST 142 U/L (3.55x ULN 40 -> CTCAE v5.0 Grade 2 elevation) | ALT 156 U/L (3.90x ULN 40 -> CTCAE v5.0 Grade 2 elevation) | Total Bilirubin 0.9 mg/dL (ULN 1.2).
- Hematology: ANC 3,800 /uL | Platelets 195,000 /uL.

=== ECOG PERFORMANCE STATUS ===
ECOG Performance Status: 1.
Assessor Note: CONTRAINDICATED for NCT04787042 due to 45 Gy thoracic/lung RT 110 days ago (<180 days) AND CTCAE Grade 2 transaminitis (AST 142, ALT 156 > 100 U/L limit).

CLINICAL ENCOUNTER: Adjuvant Thoracic Oncology Clinical Trial Screening (Target: NCT06890598 Phase 3)

=== DEMOGRAPHICS & CLINICAL SUMMARY ===
David Chen is a 64-year-old male post-operative thoracic surgery patient being evaluated for NCT06890598 (SUNRAY-02 Phase 3 Olomorasib + Standard of Care Immunotherapy, Part A).

=== DIAGNOSIS & STAGE ===
Primary Diagnosis: Pathologic Stage IIIA (pT2bN1M0) non-squamous Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC), status post upfront RUL lobectomy and mediastinal lymph node dissection on 2026-10-05 (40 days post-op, well healed).
Clinical Status: Able to swallow intact oral tablets without dysphagia or GI malabsorption. No prior history of other malignancy within 2 years, no active autoimmune disease, and no prior immunotherapy or Grade >= 3 irAE.

=== PATHOLOGY & MOLECULAR NGS ===
- Liquid Biopsy ctDNA (Guardant360, collected 2026-10-28): KRAS p.G12C mutation DETECTED (MAF 0.8%).
- Surgical Specimen Reflex Molecular Panel (EGFR exons 18-21 PCR/NGS and ALK IHC/FISH fusion): PENDING_LAB_RESULT (specimen currently in molecular pathology queue; expected turnaround 5 business days).
- Surgical Specimen PD-L1 IHC (22C3 pharmDx): PENDING_LAB_RESULT (staining pending pathologist sign-out).

=== BRAIN MRI / CNS IMAGING ===
2026-09-25 Pre-operative Brain MRI w/ contrast: Normal brain parenchyma; no intracranial metastases.

=== RADIATION ONCOLOGY HISTORY ===
- Prior Radiotherapy: None.

=== ACTIVE & PRIOR MEDICATIONS ===
- Systemic Corticosteroids: None (0 mg/day).
- Prior Systemic Anticancer Therapy: None (upfront surgical resection).
- Metformin 500 mg PO BID (well-controlled T2DM); Rosuvastatin 10 mg PO daily.

=== LABORATORY PANEL (Collected 2026-11-12) ===
- Renal Function: eGFR 84 mL/min/1.73m2.
- Hepatic Function: AST 22 U/L (ULN 40) | ALT 25 U/L (ULN 40) | Total Bilirubin 0.6 mg/dL (ULN 1.2).
- Hematology: ANC 3,900 /uL | Platelets 210,000 /uL.

=== ECOG PERFORMANCE STATUS ===
ECOG Performance Status: 0 (fully active, asymptomatic post-op recovery).
Assessor Note: NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW — patient passes all organ reserve, surgical recovery, and KRAS G12C inclusion criteria, but tissue EGFR/ALK reflex exclusion and PD-L1 expression are PENDING_LAB_RESULT.
